pulse.label: The Oaks bury Orlando early for a third straight win. Oaks 125 - Magic 109
pulse.notes: The Oaks put the Orlando Magic away in the first quarter and made it three straight, Oaks 125 - Magic 109, in front of a 94% crowd at home. Oakland scored 41 in the opening quarter to lead 41-27, went up 73-52 at the half and 101-76 after three, and the Magic only got it respectable by winning a garbage-time fourth 33-24. Adash Stanley led with 24 points, 8 assists and zero turnovers, hitting 6 of 12 from three. AJ Dybantsa bounced back from his 4 for 15 night against Oklahoma City by going 11 of 13 for 23 points, and Dillon Brooks followed his 22-point Cup opener with 23 on 10 of 14, giving him back-to-back 20-point games. Austin Reaves scored all 15 of his points from deep, 5 of 10 from three, with 7 assists, and Wendell Carter Jr. added 12 on 6 of 10. Off the bench T. Jerome had 9 points and 7 assists in 18 minutes and J. Valančiūnas went 4 for 5 for 8. Harry Hayward played 16 minutes after his 23 in Toronto and filled the line with 5 points, 2 steals and a block. As a team the Oaks shot 53 of 89, 18 of 33 from three, with 33 assists against only 4 turnovers, and went to the line just once all night. B. Simmons, who scored 5 in Toronto, was a DNP along with B. James Jr., J. Tate and Coen Carr. The Oaks move to 7-1.
